title: Fees and commissions — statutory notice (FAC-01)
text:
You need to send HMRC a return:

 • with the information asked for in the notice

 • by the date given in the notice

 To create your return you’ll need to use this spreadsheet — we will not accept any other. To do this:

 • download and save the file, if it does not download automatically

 • select ‘Enable Editing’ to enter data

 • fill in all relevant fields

 Find out  how to submit your statutory return notice .
changeNote: The FAC-01 return template has been updated and new guidance provided on how to complete it.
